parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence; foreign-passport entry, facilities, custody and care present no documented visitor-facing restriction (no tier-1 exposure). Positive: an in-force anti-discrimination law covering gender identity, and a hate-crime aggravation actually applied — a court sentenced an attacker to two years, showing recourse can work. Negatives: severe, current societal hostility (Pride 2019 assault with arrests, 2023 hate-speech surge with no state response, religious mobilisation against the small trans population, municipal hostility), and some under-policing (prosecutor inefficacy on hate speech, most violence unreported). No legal gender recognition is a resident gap and cannot be scored, but it signals institutional climate. Thin-data jurisdiction; extrapolating from structural signals (no criminalisation, functioning but uneven courts, hostile society) resolves above elevated and just below reduced-risk mid: comparable to a 0.65 anchor with weaker protection consistency.
